libraryNotes: A QUEUE_ROLE existed through Phase H but was never consumed. The vault gates its exit by the configured redemption-queue address, which is the stronger check; it was removed at Phase I cleanup.

roles.name: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE
roles.purpose: Admin of all roles (grant/revoke); every parameter setter.
roles.notice: Inherited AccessControl administrator; represented by bytes32(0).

roles.name: UPGRADER_ROLE
roles.purpose: Authorizes upgrades on role-gated UUPS modules.
roles.notice: May authorize UUPS upgrades. Held only by the governance timelock.

roles.name: GUARDIAN_ROLE
roles.purpose: Pause/unpause user paths and create one persistent reserve-loss arm; cannot release, renew, adjudicate, or execute the cascade.
roles.notice: Emergency pause/unpause on value-moving paths. Cannot upgrade or move value.

roles.name: MINTER_ROLE
roles.purpose: Mint and burn USDfr through the backing-checked controller path.
roles.notice: May mint USDfr. Held only by the MintRedeemController.

roles.name: CONTROLLER_ROLE
roles.notice: Reserve custody operations (deposit/release). Held only by the MintRedeemController.

roles.name: CREDIT_ROLE
roles.purpose: Trusted internal credit-module primitives; never an EOA.
roles.notice: Principal deployment, atomic payment receipt, and writedown. Held by credit modules.

roles.name: LOSS_BURNER_ROLE
roles.purpose: Burn protocol-owned junior capital and pro-rata senior vault assets during authenticated loss cascades; never held by WaterfallEngine or an EOA.
roles.notice: May burn USDfr to realize an authenticated loss. Held only by DefaultManager and ReserveManager.
roles.dev: AUDIT R16-M1: burnLoss is deliberately split from CREDIT_ROLE so the repayment engine cannot compose mint and burn authority.

roles.name: FEE_ACCOUNTING_ROLE
roles.purpose: Bracket fee-neutral junior-capacity changes; never an EOA.
roles.notice: May bracket a junior-capacity change so the vault preserves its asset-denominated performance-fee hurdle. Held only by the curator, sGROVE, and DefaultManager modules.

roles.name: COMPLIANCE_ADMIN_ROLE
roles.purpose: KYC allow-list and jurisdiction blocklist; cannot set protocol exemptions.
roles.notice: Manages KYC allowlist and jurisdiction blocklist entries.

roles.name: RESERVE_ADMIN_ROLE
roles.purpose: Ratify bounded reserve losses and account physically recovered reserve capital.
roles.notice: Reserve configuration and conservative USDC custody write-downs.

roles.name: ATTESTER_ROLE
roles.purpose: Authorized EIP-712 signers; the oracle verifies bundles against current holders.

roles.name: SERVICER_ROLE
roles.purpose: Facility funding, repayment distribution, default, acceleration, loss realization, and cure operations.
roles.notice: Servicing operations: facility funding, repayment distribution, default declaration, and loss realization. Held by Forest Road servicing keys until Phase G binds these paths to attested facts; the role then gates who may execute an already-attested action, not what is true.

roles.name: SETTLEMENT_KEEPER_ROLE
roles.purpose: Drive RedemptionQueue.closeEpoch and choose when its contract-bounded liquidity snapshot is taken.
roles.notice: Drives RedemptionQueue.closeEpoch. Operational, not governance or upgrade authority: it initiates a financially effective settlement and controls when its budget is sampled, but cannot choose recipients, reorder FIFO, set parameters, or exceed the contract-enforced budget and pricing rules.
roles.dev: AUDIT FIX D7-01: closeEpoch samples the epoch liquidity budget as a spot read and the fill loop re-reads it every chunk. While permissionless, a caller could hold flash liquidity across both reads; measured excess budget was $1.62M from Morpho alone and $4.31M from stacked Aave and Morpho borrowing. A flash loan cannot span two transactions, so the keeper gate closes the vector at its root. This supersedes ADR-0018 section 2's permissionless-settlement design. Grant the role to at least two holders: a hot keeper and a manual ops-multisig backstop. A total keeper outage is bounded only by governance regranting the role. A permissionless grace fallback was rejected because it would restore the flash vector whenever the keeper missed the window.

deploymentExclusions.reason: Immutable, non-AccessControl atomic executor; no role graph exists to scan or hand over.
Governor-authorized rather than AccessControl-authorized; hasRole scanning is inapplicable.
External canonical USDC in production and a role-less mock in local deployments.
